definition_zh: 容量大的；宽敞的；（胸怀、头脑）能容纳很多的
definition_en: able to hold much; having ample space, whether physical or mental
core_image: 一只张开口的口袋深不见底：什么都装得下
scene: 阁楼推开天窗，尘埃在光柱里浮动，四壁全被旧木箱占满。The capacious attic swallowed decades of family clutter.
sceneCN: 这里 capacious 是「容量大的」（第 1 个义项：能装很多东西）；句意是这个宽敞的阁楼吞下了几十年的家庭杂物。

pos.zh: （心胸、头脑）宽宏的；接受力强的

derivatives.zh: 同根核心名词，义为「容量；能力；资格」
由名词加动词化后缀构成，义为「使具有资格；使有能力」（罕用）
加否定前缀构成，义为「使失去能力；使无行为能力」

senses.title: Having ample interior space
senses.definition: physically large enough inside to hold a great deal
senses.definitionCN: 内部空间足以容纳大量物品
senses.example: She loaded the capacious trunk with winter coats.
senses.exampleCN: 她往容积很大的后备箱里塞满了冬衣。
senses.why: The Latin capax means able to hold, so the literal image is a container that never fills.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 capax 意为能容纳的，字面意象就是一只总装不满的容器。

senses.title: Broad in mental grasp
senses.definition: able to take in and absorb a great deal of knowledge or experience
senses.definitionCN: 能够吸收大量知识或经验
senses.example: His capacious memory held every birthday in the village.
senses.exampleCN: 他记性极好，村里每个人的生日都记得。
senses.why: The mind is treated as a container, and a capacious one holds more before overflowing.
senses.whyCN: 心智被当作容器，容量大者在溢出之前能装下更多。

senses.title: Tolerant and embracing in outlook
senses.definition: willing to accommodate many views, people, or styles without narrowness
senses.definitionCN: 愿意容纳多种观点、人群或风格而不显狭隘
senses.example: The city's capacious culture absorbed wave after wave of newcomers.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市兼容并包的文化吸收了一波又一波新来者。
senses.why: Roominess extends from shelves and bags to attitudes and institutions.
senses.whyCN: 「空间充裕」从书架和提包延伸到态度与制度。

intro.en: Capacious comes from Latin capax, able to hold much, from capere, to take or seize, one of the most productive roots in Latin.
intro.cn: capacious 来自拉丁语 capax（能容纳许多的），词根 capere（拿取、抓住）是拉丁语中最高产的词根之一。

items.en: The root *kap- means to grasp or seize, seen in have and heave.
items.cn: 词根 *kap- 意为抓住、握取，英语 have、heave 亦与之相关。

items.en: Latin capere meant to take, seize, or hold; its adjective capax meant roomy and receptive.
items.cn: 拉丁语 capere 意为拿取、抓住、容纳；其形容词 capax 意为宽敞的、善于接纳的。

items.en: English took capacious from French forms in the seventeenth century for physical roominess first.
items.cn: 英语于十七世纪经法语借入 capacious，最初用于形容物理空间的宽敞。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the mental sense was common, praising capacious memories and minds.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，心智义已很常见，用来称赞博闻强记与开阔的头脑。

items.en: Today it prefers grand containers: bags, halls, memories, and civic cultures.
items.cn: 如今它偏爱形容大容器：提包、大厅、记忆与城市文化。

note.en: Capacious heads a family of hold-words stretching from capture to capacity.
note.cn: capacious 是「容纳」词族之首，从 capture 一路延伸到 capacity。

entries.definition: The amount that can be held, or the ability to do something.
One who has been taken and held, from the seize root.
entries.definitionCN: 俘虏；被捉住的人，出自「抓取」词根。

entries.definition: Given to faultfinding; looks and sounds close but means critical rather than roomy.
entries.definitionCN: 吹毛求疵的，形近音近，义为「爱挑刺」而非「容量大」。

entries.definition: A large flightless bird; purely coincidental sound resemblance.
entries.definitionCN: 食火鸡，与 capacious 只是发音偶然相似。

entries.definition: Having ample space, emphasizing openness over holding power.
entries.definitionCN: 宽敞的，侧重开阔而非装载力。

entries.definition: Having plenty of room, everyday register.
Spreading out widely, or generous in manner.

entries.definitionCN: 狭窄局促的，是 capacious 的反义对照。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the hold root and the never-full container.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「容纳」词根与「装不满的容器」的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Root core: Latin capere, to take and hold, is the same root in capture and captive.
normal.cn: 词根核心：拉丁语 capere（拿取、容纳）也是 capture、captive 的词根。

normal.en: Adjective engine: capax plus -ious gives capacious, just as audax gives audacious.
normal.cn: 形容词引擎：capax 加 -ious 得 capacious，正如 audax 加 -ious 得 audacious。

normal.en: Noun home: the plain noun of the family is capacity, the amount it holds.
normal.cn: 名词归宿：词族的普通名词是 capacity，即容纳量。

normal.en: Trap guard: captious means faultfinding, not roomy; never confuse the pair.
normal.cn: 陷阱防守：captious 是吹毛求疵，不是容量大，切勿混淆。

normal.en: Upgrade pair: capacious is spacious with ambition, saved for big bags and bigger minds.
normal.cn: 升级搭配：capacious 是胸怀大志的 spacious，专配大包与更大的头脑。

abstract.en: A carpetbag that seems bottomless, accepting coat after coat without complaint.
abstract.cn: 一只仿佛没有底的旅行袋，一件接一件地吞下大衣毫无怨言。

abstract.en: A library whose aisles keep folding into new shelves as you walk.
abstract.cn: 一座越走越深的图书馆，书架随脚步不断折叠出新。

abstract.en: A harbor at dusk holding ships of every flag without a ripple of complaint.
abstract.cn: 黄昏的港口，悬挂万国旗的船只静静停泊，波澜不惊。

examples.en: The stadium's capacious bowl absorbed the rain-soaked crowd.
examples.cn: 体育场容量巨大的看台装下了浑身湿透的人群。

examples.en: Her capacious curiosity ranged from beetles to symphonies.
examples.cn: 她求知欲极强，从甲虫到交响乐无所不涉。

examples.en: The novel needs a capacious reader willing to hold ten plots at once.
examples.cn: 这部小说需要一位胸怀宽广、能同时容纳十条情节线的读者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克配顺」——什么都能克化、都能配上、都能顺进肚里，正是容量超大、来者不拒；联想一只永远装不满的大口袋。

root: 源自拉丁语 capax（能容纳的），词根 capere（拿取、抓住、容纳），可上溯至印欧词根 *kap-（抓取）。同根词极多：capacity（容量）、captive（俘虏）、capture（捕获）、capture 与 accept、concept 皆含此根。十七世纪经法语进入英语，先表物理容积，后扩展至心智与胸襟。

sensesIntro.en: From roomy containers the word grows into capacious minds and tolerant cultures.
sensesIntro.cn: 从宽敞的容器出发，词义生长为博大的头脑与兼容的文化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a container that never fills, accepting whatever arrives.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只永远装不满的容器，来者不拒。

branches.en: THE WAREHOUSE: bags, trunks, and halls that swallow cargo.
branches.cn: 仓库：吞下货物的提包、箱柜与大厅。

branches.en: THE STUDY: memories and intellects that hold whole libraries.
branches.cn: 书房：装下整座图书馆的记忆与才智。

branches.en: THE HARBOR: cultures making room for every arrival.
branches.cn: 港口：为每个到来者留出位置的文化。

branches.en: THE MEASURE: capacity as the noun that quantifies the adjective.
branches.cn: 度量：capacity 是给这个形容词定量的名词。

branches.en: THE VIRTUE: roominess of mind praised as generosity.
branches.cn: 美德：心灵的宽敞被赞为慷慨。

intro.en: Capacious is the Latin stem cap- plus the adjective ending -acious, literally much-holding.
intro.cn: capacious 由拉丁词干 cap- 加形容词词尾 -acious 构成，字面即「能容纳很多的」。

latinIntro.en: The capere root is a Latin engine room, powering dozens of English words about taking and holding.
latinIntro.cn: capere 词根是拉丁语的发动机室，驱动着英语中数十个关于拿取与容纳的词。

items.exampleCN: 拿在手中（拉丁语用例示意）。
能容万物（拉丁语用例示意）。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 善于接纳的心智（拉丁语用例示意）。
